blurb: Guests take approximately one-hour hot air balloon flights at sunrise over the Continental Divide and Rocky Mountain National Park. Flights include a traditional champagne toast and are led by an experienced FAA commercial pilot. The location offers unique mountain flying with views into seven Colorado counties and wildlife spotting opportunities.
